**The task (high priority, Nisha Rao as C03's owner):** Stop Creator Partners (C03) and reallocate its remaining budget to the scale channels C06/C05/C01.

**Evidence (as of 25 Mar 2025):**
- C03 breached the pre-committed **stop** rule: ₹205.91 per registration = 1.86x the blended ₹110.63 (stop threshold 1.6x); confirmation 81.3% vs 88% min; form completion 81.6% vs 88% min; opt-outs 18.7% vs 15% max. ₹48,800 spent for just 237 registrations.
- Where the money should go instead (all "scale" decisions): C06 Organic Search ₹57.44, C05 Student Referrals ₹77.23, C01 Campus Ambassadors ₹86.65 per registration.
- Why now: 2,032 of 3,200 registrations; run rate 44.79/day vs 68.71/day needed (projected 2,793). Only ₹75,200 of the ₹3,00,000 budget remains, so every extra C03 rupee at 1.86x cost works against the goal.

**Dropped #2, for the record:** fixing C02 Paid Social — opt-outs 24.4% (94 of 385 nurture sends) vs the 15% cap, confirmation 84.9% vs 88%, ₹127.79 per registration (owner Arjun Verma). Say the word if you want it back.

If useful, I can also prepare the C03 status change to "stopped" on the campaign itself, and run a what-if on the reallocation split.
